injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Poehling has been on injured reserve since Oct. 13, and the Ducks announced at the time that he was expected to miss approximately 6-8 weeks. His move to long-term injured reserve shouldn't impact his return timetable, but the Ducks will get reinforcements moving forward after Troy Terry (hip) was activated off injured reserve Wednesday.

injuries.name: Ian Moore
injuries.note: Moore hasn't made his season debut yet because of the injury. He's expected to miss Wednesday's game in Nashville, but perhaps he'll be an option Saturday versus the Islanders or Sunday against Calgary. Moore had four goals and 12 points in 67 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. He might play on the third pairing once he's healthy.

injuries.name: A.J. Greer
injuries.note: Greer suffered an upper-body injury in Sunday's 6-3 win over Ottawa. He will miss at least the next four games, starting with Tuesday's matchup against Vancouver, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Greer has four goals, six points, 23 shots on net and 36 hits in 13 appearances this season.

injuries.name: Ian Moore

injuries.name: Ryan Poehling
injuries.note: Lower-Body: The Anaheim Ducks placed F Ryan Poehling on long-term injured reserve on Wednesday (Nov. 11).

injuries.name: James Hagens
injuries.note: After being placed on injured reserve early Saturday morning, Hagens' timeline for recovery has been revealed to keep him sidelined for at least the next five or six games. It's an unfortunate break for the Bruins and the 20-year-old winger, as he had posted six goals, 12 points, 34 shots on net and 19 blocked shots over 17 games prior to going down. His absence might hurt his rookie of the year case in the long run, but once he's able to return, he'll give the Bruins' third line a major boost. In his absence, expect the newly recalled Michael Eyssimont, who was named the AHL's player of the month for October, to take his place.

He will miss his fourth straight game Thursday and will be eligible to return whenever ready, as long as he doesn't later end up on long-term injured reserve.

injuries.name: Matt Grzelcyk
injuries.note: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.

The Flames return home to face the Wild on Thursday, but it's not yet clear whether Huberdeau will be in the mix to suit up for that game.

injuries.note: Bichsel exited Thursday's matchup against the Jets in the first period due to a lower-body injury, and the Stars indicated after the game that the 22-year-old was expected to miss the team's back-to-back set over the weekend. However, he's slated to miss even more time than that, and he'll likely be unavailable until at least late November. Kyle Burroughs will be recalled from AHL Texas to provide additional depth for Dallas, while it seems possible that Bichsel will wind up on injured reserve at some point.

injuries.note: While Heiskanen's status for Sunday's clash with the Panthers wasn't specifically mentioned, the fact that the team is heading into a back-to-back doesn't bode well for the blueliner's availability. The 27-year-old Finn is currently stuck in an eight-game goal drought, but he picked up five helpers over that stretch, including two with the man advantage. With Lian Bichsel (lower body) also sidelined, the Stars are expected to bring Kyle Burroughs up from the minors.
